correctness.rationale: Writing the published SODE as a four-dimensional first-order system gives Qdot=cQ by direct substitution. Q=0 is invariant and exactly reconstructs the original Liu equations through y=x+v/a; x=v=0, z=A exp(ct)+B exp(-ct) gives an explicit family of extra SODE solutions when A is nonzero. Linearization at the origin independently shows the added +c eigenvalue. The packaged algebraic checker reproduces these identities.
